rule: These three eight-character principles are the permanent Governance Root. They may be quoted or referenced, but not rewritten, thawed, version-swapped, semantically redefined, or replaced by downstream architecture, UI, Search, RAG, historical documents, or implementation details.

principles.provenance: confirmed 2026-09-17; this is the newly consolidated recent principle

governance_effect.historical: Preserve and consult history without promoting legacy semantics into Current authority.
governance_effect.pluralism: Seek shared ground while preserving legitimate differences and their provenance.
governance_effect.authority: Read, reference and analyze across scopes without acquiring governance authority over another scope.
governance_effect.self_governance: Freedom remains bounded by one's own responsibility and declared boundary.
governance_effect.implementation: Current architecture and implementation may evolve so long as they do not violate this Governance Root.
